crm_notes: Inbound SMB: FastReply.ai builds automated first-response for SMB support teams.
Primary pain: EU customers experiencing sluggish response times; end-users complain about spinner timeouts.
They are self-serve first, evaluating hosted API to avoid infra ops. Cost sensitive but need responsive UX for chat.
Reported targets: interactive chat p95 <= 800ms ideally; currently seeing p95 ~2.5s from EU.
Workload profile: multi-turn chat with system prompt ~180 tokens, user messages avg 120 tokens, expected response avg 120 tokens (short summaries/answers).
Customer uses our default SDK config; did not set region param (falls back to us-east). EU traffic routed across region -> higher latency.
- Set region override to 'eu-west-1' (closest infra) for EU-heavy traffic
- Increase client-side timeout to 90-120s to avoid aborted streams on occasional long generations
- Set max_tokens to 150 and prune system prompt to 80-100 tokens where possible (use placeholders for dynamic data)
- Enable streaming responses in SDK so UI can render partial tokens earlier (perceived latency improvement)
- Use smaller, faster model variant for routine routing (e.g., 'rwd-3.5-small' for short answers) and reserve 'rwd-4-large' for high-value queries
- Use caching for repeated frequently asked questions and prefix caching for multi-turn sessions
- Add client-side exponential backoff and retry for transient 5xx or 429s
Notes from call: customer said 'if we can't get EU under ~1s p95 users won't adopt'
SE action items: run a short A/B test between eu region + streaming vs default; provide sample config snippets and latency matrix
Potential upsell: Dedicated reserved capacity if traffic grows and they need guaranteed tail latency
Security: SOC2 acceptable for now; no immediate SSO requirement (SMB).
technical_summary: - Region mismatch: traffic from EU routed to us-east by default
- Long system prompts increasing token processing time
- No streaming enabled -> UI waits for full response
- Client timeout set too low causing truncated UX
- Use eu region for EU users -> expect ~30-50% reduction in network RTT
- Aim for p95 <= 800ms by combining region, streaming, and smaller model for routine queries
- model_routing: 'rwd-3.5-small' for default, fallback to 'rwd-4-large' for complex requests
Additional ops notes: Enable request tracing headers and send a sample request_id for support investigations.
